limitations: Dash only via held D (donor X); tap-turn input unchanged
Vertical donor motion ignored; horizontal only scaled by unitScale
Sweep visualisation only; final wraparound and collisions remain recipient logic
candidate.mapping: Adapter holds core state from motion.init(config.motion) once. Each step maps frame.facing to donor left(16)/right(32) and frame.dash to donor X(1), calls motion.step with sourceBodyWidth 8 and config.motion. If donor ownsMotion false returns frame.normalDisplacement with empty sweep; if true returns donor displacement.x*unitScale. Copies ownsMotion/events exactly. Sweep is integer 1px offsets from 0 toward displacement excluding endpoints.

humanAssistance: Selected recipient and authored movement/draw ports
Specified control, unit-scale, and fixed-tick policies
Authored independent conformance and browser checks
